slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: categories
slots.about: the shelves in order: id, name

slots.name: tags
slots.about: up to four filters over every shelf: id (1 or more), name

slots.name: items
slots.about: the things on the shelves: id, category (a category id), tag (a tag id), name, note (a short second line, may be blank), liked (true or false)

slots.name: more_word
slots.about: the shelf button while it shows two, e.g. See all

slots.name: less_word
slots.about: the shelf button while it shows everything, e.g. Show less

slots.name: like_word
slots.about: spoken before an item's name on its like button when not liked

slots.name: unlike_word
slots.about: spoken before an item's name on its like button when liked

slots.name: empty_text
slots.about: what shows when nothing is on any shelf, or nothing matches the filter

empty.shows: empty; with no items at all the chips hide too

fallback.shows: a shelf with two or fewer has no See all button

attention.shows: the picked chip fills; shelves with nothing left under the filter hide

labels.more: more_word or less_word and the shelf name
labels.like: like_word or unlike_word and the item name

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, shrink and swap
